main_text.p: & primò quidem In genere Q. III. paginis fere integris duabus distinctione potestatis Magistratus formaliter & objectivè consideratę; tum in specie Quæstionib.seqq. Quemadmodum etiam hinc inde in Disputat. speciatim in Conclusione, inculcatur, Magistratum non debere involare in partes eas, quæ ministerio Ecclesiastico propriæ sunt. Non non potest, aut debet Magistratus ipse cōcionari, administrare Sacramenta, exercere disciplinā [?] Ecclesiasticam, ut non semel indisputatione moneo. Nec etiā sibi debet arrogare potestatem talem, quam ipse à Christo & quidem solus immediatè accepit, ita ut ministri, aut nomine ipsius concionentur, Sacramenta administrent, disciplinam exerceant, Ecclesiam gubernent; aut excludantur ab Electione seu vocatione ministrorum & à judiciis Ecclesiasticis, quos errores Arminianorum statim in proœmio longissimè & expressissimè rejeci.
main_text.head: QUÆST. IV. An Magistratus habeat potestatem vocandi Pastores seu ministros Ecclesiæ?

page.notes: Running head "Q. III." is set with a large decorative Q; read as QUÆST. III. Possible printed errors: "Non non potest" (the printed "Non n." is followed by "potest"; read as "Non non potest"); "Sacramenta, exercere" has a stray mark before "exercere". "disciplinā [?]": the abbreviation mark over "a" after "disciplin" is uncertain. "Pagina" is hyphenated as "pa-gins" at the line end; read as "paginis". Long s rendered as plain s throughout. No margin notes, catchword, or signature other than "B 4" visible. The paragraph has no indent at the top, so it continues from the previous page. The stray marks in "Ecclesiam gubernent" and "ministros" are show-through or damage, not text.
